text: The authors identify a drafting defect in the proposed CRD IV Regulation: the distinction drawn by financial institution in Article 51(a) is ambiguous and the cross reference to the institution referred to in point (a) of Article 87 is unclear and indeterminate, so the provision requires clarification or amendment.
citation: Christoph K. Henkel, Wulf A. Kaal, Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2061166

isBasedOn.name: Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring

abstract: the distinction is ambiguous and requires further clarification or amendment. Specifically, the statutory reference in § 51, ¶ (a) ("of the institution referred to in point (a) of Article 87") is unclear and indeterminate.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Article 51 of the proposed CRD IV Regulation as drafted
